```python
def parse_lonestar_payload(p):

        "tracking_number": p.get("references", {}).get("carrierTrackingId"),
        "temp_c": p.get("telemetry", {}).get("tempC"),
    }
```

**Tested output with your sample payload:**

```python
parse_lonestar_payload(p) 
# -> {'tracking_number': 'LS-88214-A', 'temp_c': 11.2}
```

This should now correctly parse both fields for your pharma cold-chain shipments.
